title: Explainable GeoAI for urban wildfire structure loss: vegetation and built environment in the 2025 Palisades Fire
abstract: arXiv:2608.22293v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Urban wildfire resilience depends on interactions among built form, vegetation condition, and extreme fire weather, yet city-scale risk models often overlook whether predictive skill transfers across neighborhoods. We developed a spatially validated GeoAI workflow for the January 2025 Palisades Fire, linking 12,081 CAL FIRE damage inspections to pre-fire Sentinel-2 vegetation indices, Landsat surface temperature, LANDFIRE fuels, terrain, and OpenStreetMap buildings and roads. Among 9,883 inspected residential structures, 5,566 were destroyed. Random cross-validation yielded ROC-AUC 0.92 for the integrated XGBoost model, but 1 km spatial block validation reduced performance to 0.75; logistic regression performed similarly and was better calibrated. Building count within 100 m was the strongest predictor, with destruction odds increasing 4.12-fold per standard deviation. Vegetation moisture and greenness showed opposing condition

translated_title: 面向城市野火建筑损失的可解释地理空间人工智能（GeoAI）：2025年帕利塞德斯大火中的植被与建成环境
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22293v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：城市野火韧性取决于建筑形态、植被状况与极端火险天气之间的相互作用，然而城市尺度的风险模型往往忽视其预测能力能否在不同街区之间迁移。我们针对2025年1月的帕利塞德斯大火开发了一套经空间验证的GeoAI工作流程，将12,081份加州消防局（CAL FIRE）损失检查记录与灾前的Sentinel-2植被指数、Landsat地表温度、LANDFIRE燃料数据、地形数据以及OpenStreetMap的建筑和道路数据相关联。在9,883栋受检住宅建筑中，有5,566栋被毁。随机交叉验证显示，整合的XGBoost模型ROC-AUC达到0.92，但在1公里空间分块验证下性能降至0.75；逻辑回归表现相近且校准效果更好。100米范围内的建筑数量是最强的预测因子，每增加一个标准差，建筑被毁的几率增加4.12倍。植被湿度与绿度表现出相反的条件（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究构建了可解释的GeoAI模型预测2025年帕利塞德斯大火的建筑损毁情况，发现100米范围内建筑密度是最强预测因子，并通过空间分块验证揭示了模型在跨街区迁移时性能显著下降。
en_tdlr: This study developed an explainable GeoAI workflow to predict structure loss in the 2025 Palisades Fire, identifying building count within 100 m as the strongest predictor of destruction, while spatial block validation revealed that model performance drops substantially when transferring across neighborhoods.
